Sam usually has chicken for breakfast. Last Saturday, Sam and Owen went to the hotel. Sam borrowed a book about science from the zoo. The painter is repainting our classroom walls this week.
Owen's birthday is in February. Owen is interested in singing. Sam thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. He is best known for his sharp observational comedy.

Sam and Owen had great fun there. It takes twenty minutes to get to the hotel by bike. There are always many people at the old town. What's more, the family farm expanded its acreage by renting the field next door.
Sam learned a lot about science. They took many photos at the old town. Sam hopes to visit Toronto one day.
